name: oh-my-fable
description: Get the best out of Claude Fable 5.1 in Claude Code (output quality goes up on Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 too): install and forget: the always-on prompting rules load at every session start and reach subagents, unattended sessions are detected automatically, /fable-prompt turns a rough request into a guide-aligned prompt, /fable-status shows what is in effect, /fable-setup is optional.
